strongest_angle: In October 2026, Beyoncé's management company Parkwood Entertainment filed a motion asking a California federal court to make plaintiff Shuji Hirose and his attorney DaShawn Hayes pay legal bills for an objectively baseless second lawsuit over the song Alien Superstar.

key_facts.fact: On October 15, 2026, Parkwood Entertainment filed motions in a California federal court asking for a permanent dismissal and financial penalties against plaintiff Shuji Hirose and his attorney DaShawn Hayes.
Parkwood Entertainment filed court papers in Los Angeles asking a federal court to make music rights owner Shuji Hirose and his lawyer pay its legal bills over the song Alien Superstar.
